description: The two pie charts, labeled (a) and (b), display the distribution of certain categories. Chart (a) is divided into five slices, representing the categories "in", "this", "for", "to", and "the", with corresponding percentages of 31%, 21%, 17%, 15%, and 7% respectively, and are colored in blue with vertical stripes, blue with horizontal stripes, green with a grid pattern, yellow with a wavy pattern, and grey, respectively. Chart (b) is also divided into four slices, representing the categories "the", "$", "equilibrium", and "consatant", with corresponding percentages of 38%, 27%, 19%, and 15% respectively, and are colored in blue with diagonal stripes, red with dots, yellow, and grey with diagonal stripes, respectively. Both charts include percentage labels inside the slices and a legend above the charts, and the slices in both charts are arranged in a descending order of size.
